requirements_summary.summary: Participium is a web application for the Municipality of Turin enabling citizens to report urban issues (e.g., potholes, trash) via an interactive map or Telegram bot. Reports undergo a lifecycle from submission and approval by a Public Relations Officer to assignment, resolution by technical offices or external maintainers, and public visibility. The system supports role-based access for citizens, staff, administrators, and external partners, with features for notifications, statistics, and internal communication.

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to assign reports to external maintainers
So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
constraints: It can be possible for specific reports of certain categories (e.g., Enel X for category Public Lighting) based on their content reviewed by the technical office staff member.
expected_behaviors: specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention

requirements.text:
As an external maintainer 
I want to update the status of a report assigned to me
So that I can updated citizens about  the intervention.
expected_behaviors: I can updated citizens about  the intervention

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member/external maintainer
I want to exchange information and comments on the report internally
So that coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
expected_behaviors: coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
constraints: Registration is required before submitting reports.
expected_behaviors: I can access the Participium system and submit reports

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to confirm my registration with a code
So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
constraints: Once a registration is completed, the user gets an email with a confirmation code. The person can use the application only after confirming by entering the code valid for 30 minutes.
expected_behaviors: my account becomes valid and I can start using the system

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to set up municipality users
constraints: These are the internal accounts of the municipality

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to assign roles to municipality users
constraints: Possible roles: municipal public relations officer, municipal administrator, technical office staff member, external maintainer. You can be more specific on technical offices to run realisti scenarios following the official organizational structure of the municipality of Turin (https://trasparenza.comune.torino.it/media/2212/download)

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to select a location on the city map
So that my report is geolocated with latitude and longitude.
constraints: Reports must be tied to a specific location. Use OpenStreet Map (or any other derivative map based on it), standard layer
expected_behaviors: my report is geolocated with latitude and longitude

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to provide details for my report 
So that the the problem is classified correctly.
constraints: Mandatory fields: title, description,  category , photos (min 1 max 3).
expected_behaviors: the the problem is classified correctly

requirements.text:
As a municipal public relations officer
I want to review and approve or reject reports 
So that only valid reports are processed further.
constraints: Rejected reports must include an explanation. If accepted, the report is assigned to the technical office bound to the report category.
expected_behaviors: only valid reports are processed further

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to choose whether to make my report anonymous 
So that my name is not shown in the public list of reports.
constraints: Anonymous option protects privacy. Choice made at issue description time.
expected_behaviors: my name is not shown in the public list of reports

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to see the list of reports assigned to me
So that I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done
expected_behaviors: I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to configure my account
So that I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence.
constraints: Citizens can  upload a personal photo, add their Telegram username and switch off/on email notifications in the configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to modify roles to municipality users
So that the staff can be more flexible.
constraints: This story overwrites a previous answer given by PO on the Telegram chat. NB: 1) A municipality user can now have multiple roles, i.e. serving on more than one technical office. 2) Modification includes cancellation.
expected_behaviors: the staff can be more flexible

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
constraints: At each status change, the citizen receives notification in the platform with the corresponding update. Municipal operators working on reports can also send messages to the citizens in the platform, to which the citizen can reply.
expected_behaviors: citizens are informed of the problem resolution process

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to receive optional email alerts in addition to platform notifications 
So that I can choose the best way to stay updated.
constraints: Unless disabled in their configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can choose the best way to stay updated

domain_rules: Reports must be tied to a specific location (latitude and longitude).
Mandatory fields for reports: title, description, category, photos (1-3).
Report statuses: Pending Approval, Assigned, In Progress, Suspended, Rejected, Resolved.
Rejected reports require an explanation from the Municipality Organization Office.
Accepted reports move to 'Assigned' and are sent to competent technical office based on category.
Automatic assignment is possible only if previously set by municipal administrator.
Internal comments between staff/external maintainers are reserved and not visible to citizens.
Only authenticated users (citizens) can view reports initially; later unregistered users can also view them.
Anonymous user's name is visible to staff but hidden in public map/table views.
Once a report is inserted, it cannot be modified or deleted by the citizen.
Email is mandatory for registration and can be used for login.
Confirmation code valid for 30 minutes; account invalid until confirmed.
Public statistics include reports by category and trends; Private statistics include detailed breakdowns (status, type, reporter).
External maintainers must have individual accounts added by system administrator.
Notifications can be real-time or on refresh based on user preference.
edge_cases: User submits report without confirming registration code within 30 minutes (account remains invalid).
User attempts to edit/delete a submitted report (action blocked).
External maintainer resolves report via Participium (Case 1) vs. external update (Case 2).
Citizen follows a closed report (action blocked; only not closed reports can be followed).
Download CSV with active filters includes only filtered data.
Zooming out on map groups reports cumulatively; zooming in separates them.
Telegram bot commands fail if user has not provided Telegram username or enabled notifications.
assumptions: The system uses OpenStreetMap as the standard layer for location selection.
External maintainers without Participium access (Case 2) communicate out-of-scope; only technical office updates status.
Telegram bot integration requires user to upload Telegram username in configuration panel.
Email notifications are sent unless explicitly disabled in configuration panel.
Technical offices are pre-configured with specific categories by the system administrator.
Real-time vs. refresh notification preference applies globally or per-report based on implementation (assumed global for simplicity unless specified).
The 'top 1%' and 'top 5%' reporters in statistics refer to most active reporters by report count.

authentication_notes: /auth/* endpoints are for login/logout and profile retrieval; they themselves require auth (except login which sets session).
/citizens/* endpoints require citizen authentication after login or registration+email verification.
/internal/* endpoints require internal user authentication with appropriate roles.
/reports/map and /reports/getById/{id} are public and do not require authentication.
/categories is public and does not require authentication.
Operations marked auth_required need an authenticated session during test setup.

risks: PUT /admin/internal-users/{id} allows overwriting roles; accidental omission of required companyId for External Maintainer role could cause validation error.
PATCH /internal/reports/{id} enforces strict status transitions; invalid state changes will return 400/403.
POST /citizens/report requires authentication but does not specify which user types can create reports; potential access control ambiguity.
DELETE /files/temp/{fileId} accepts UUID format; if fileId is reused or leaked, unintended deletion could occur.
GET /internal/reports/assigned returns reports for both technical staff and external maintainers; role-based filtering must be enforced server-side to prevent data leakage.
POST /email-verification/resend has rate limit but no explicit backoff guidance in documentation; clients may need to implement exponential backoff.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a PATCH request to delegate a report. Ensure the user is authenticated as 'technical office staff member'. Verify that the response indicates successful delegation and that the external maintainer's ID is recorded.
setup_needed: Create an authenticated session for a 'technical office staff member' user.
Ensure a report exists in the 'Assigned' status (created via POST /citizens/report and assigned).
Identify a valid external maintainer ID to delegate to.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present. Note: Delegation updates state, not resources.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core workflow of requirement PT24 where staff delegates work to external parties.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: External maintainer updates the status of a report assigned to them.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a PATCH request to update the status of a specific report. Ensure the user is authenticated as 'external maintainer'. Update the status to 'In Progress' or 'Resolved' depending on the scenario.
setup_needed: Create an authenticated session for an 'external maintainer' user.
Ensure a report exists in 'Assigned' status and is assigned to this external maintainer.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core workflow of requirement PT25 allowing maintainers to update progress.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member/external maintainer exchanges information and comments on the report internally.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a POST request to add an internal comment to a report. Ensure the user is authenticated as either 'technical office staff member' or 'external maintainer'. Verify that the comment is created and stored in the system.
setup_needed: Create an authenticated session for a 'technical office staff member' user.
Ensure a report exists in the system.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core workflow of requirement PT26 for internal coordination without exposing notes to citizens.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a PATCH request to delegate a report. Ensure the user is authenticated as 'technical office staff member'. Attempt to delegate a report that is currently in 'Pending Approval' status (not yet assigned). Verify that the operation fails or returns an error indicating the report must be assigned first.
setup_needed: Create an authenticated session for a 'technical office staff member' user.
Ensure a report exists in 'Pending Approval' status.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the dependency edge where delegation requires the report to be in 'Assigned' state first.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Municipal public relations officer reviews and approves or rejects reports.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a PATCH request to update the status of a report. Ensure the user is authenticated as 'municipal public relations officer'. Attempt to reject a report without providing an explanation in the payload. Verify that the operation fails because rejected reports require an explanation.
setup_needed: Create an authenticated session for a 'municipal public relations officer' user.
Ensure a report exists in 'Pending Approval' status.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the negative case where domain rules mandate an explanation for rejected reports.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member sees the list of reports assigned to them.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a GET request to retrieve the list of assigned reports. Ensure the user is authenticated as 'technical office staff member'. Attempt to access the endpoint without being authenticated (simulate by not providing auth headers). Verify that the operation fails with an unauthorized error.
setup_needed: Ensure no active session exists for the user.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the negative case of unauthorized access to internal endpoints.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: System administrator assigns roles to municipality users.
strategy_items.prompt: Update an existing internal user (created in a previous step or via setup) to assign a specific role. Verify the response confirms the role change and returns 200 OK.
setup_needed: Create an internal user via POST /admin/internal-users to obtain a valid ID for this test.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the created internal user using DELETE /admin/internal-users/{id} if it was created specifically for this test.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates role assignment capability as per PT03.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: System administrator sets up municipality users.
strategy_items.prompt: Create a new internal user with valid data. Then, immediately attempt to update the same user's role using PUT /admin/internal-users/{id} without first verifying the user exists or checking for any state changes.
setup_needed: Create an internal user via POST /admin/internal-users to obtain a valid ID.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the created internal user using DELETE /admin/internal-users/{id} if it was created specifically for this test.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the stateful dependency where a user must exist before their role can be updated, as per PT02 and PT03.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen selects a location on the city map to geolocate their report with latitude and longitude.
strategy_items.prompt: Create a test case where a verified citizen submits a new report including valid latitude and longitude coordinates. Verify that the response includes the report ID, status 'Pending Approval', and echoes back the provided location data.
setup_needed: Ensure citizen is registered and email verified (via POST /email-verification/verify) to obtain a valid session token.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core functionality of geolocating reports as per PT04 and domain rules requiring location data.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen configures their account to better manage notifications and virtual presence.
strategy_items.prompt: Update the authenticated citizen's profile to enable real-time notifications and set a specific notification preference. Verify the updated preferences are reflected in the GET /citizens/me response.
setup_needed: Ensure citizen is registered, email verified, and has a valid session token.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the ability to configure account settings (PT09) as per domain rules on notifications.
